    BIDS Dataset Handler

    Bids.Rd

    BIDS Dataset Handler

    BIDS Dataset Handler

    Details

    A class for managing and accessing BIDS(Brain Imaging Data Structure) motions data. See [BIDS Motion](https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/modality-specific-files/motion.html) for more details.

    Public fields

    root

    A character string. The root directory of the BIDS dataset.

    index

    A tibble containing the BIDS dataset index.

    readonly

    Logical. Default is TRUE.

    Method load_motion()

    Load the motion files. E.g. *motion.tsv.

    Usage

    Bids$load_motion(
  ...,
  empty_check = TRUE,
  merge_attr = "subject",
  type_check = "strict"
)

    Arguments

    ...

    A list of filter conditions. Use session, task, tracksys, acq, run, datatype to filter.

    empty_check

    Logical. If TRUE (default), automatically filters out empty.

    merge_attr

    A character vector specifying which attributes to merge. Default: c("subject").

    type_check

    Character. Determines how to handle type conflicts across files. Use "strict" (default) to abort on conflicts, or "auto" to automatically resolve conflicts. In auto mode, numeric conversion is attempted first if possible (all values can be converted), otherwise character conversion is used.

    Returns

    A tibble containing the motion files with subject and other index columns. e.g. session, task, tracksys, acq, run.
